title: Psalm 64
opening_line: When I to thee my prayer make,

source.note: Received text from the official Free Church digital edition and plain-text archive.

text.diplomatic: When I to thee my prayer make,
text.normalized: When I to thee my prayer make,
text.reading: When I to thee my prayer make,

text.diplomatic: Lord, to my voice give ear;
text.normalized: Lord, to my voice give ear;
text.reading: Lord, to my voice give ear;

text.diplomatic: My life save from the enemy,
text.normalized: My life save from the enemy,
text.reading: My life save from the enemy,

text.diplomatic: of whom I stand in fear.
text.normalized: Of whom I stand in fear.
text.reading: of whom I stand in fear.

text.diplomatic: Me from their secret counsel hide
text.normalized: Me from their secret counsel hide
text.reading: Me from their secret counsel hide

text.diplomatic: who do live wickedly;
text.normalized: Who do live wickedly;
text.reading: who do live wickedly;

text.diplomatic: From insurrection of those men
text.normalized: From insurrection of those men
text.reading: From insurrection of those men

text.diplomatic: that work iniquity:
text.normalized: That work iniquity:
text.reading: that work iniquity:

text.diplomatic: Who do their tongues with malice whet,
text.normalized: Who do their tongues with malice whet,
text.reading: Who do their tongues with malice whet,

text.diplomatic: and make them cut like swords;
text.normalized: And make them cut like swords;
text.reading: and make them cut like swords;

text.diplomatic: In whose bent bows are arrows set,
text.normalized: In whose bent bows are arrows set,
text.reading: In whose bent bows are arrows set,

text.diplomatic: ev’n sharp and bitter words:
text.normalized: Ev’n sharp and bitter words:
text.reading: ev’n sharp and bitter words:

text.diplomatic: That they may at the perfect man
text.normalized: That they may at the perfect man
text.reading: That they may at the perfect man

text.diplomatic: in secret aim their shot;
text.normalized: In secret aim their shot;
text.reading: in secret aim their shot;

text.diplomatic: Yea, suddenly they dare at him
text.normalized: Yea, suddenly they dare at him
text.reading: Yea, suddenly they dare at him

text.diplomatic: to shoot, and fear it not.
text.normalized: To shoot, and fear it not.
text.reading: to shoot, and fear it not.

text.diplomatic: In ill encourage they themselves,
text.normalized: In ill encourage they themselves,
text.reading: In ill encourage they themselves,

text.diplomatic: and their snares close do lay:
text.normalized: And their snares close do lay:
text.reading: and their snares close do lay:

text.diplomatic: Together conference they have;
text.normalized: Together conference they have;
text.reading: Together conference they have;

text.diplomatic: Who shall them see? they say.
text.normalized: Who shall them see? they say.
text.reading: Who shall them see? they say.

text.diplomatic: They have searched out iniquities,
text.normalized: They have searched out iniquities,
text.reading: They have searched out iniquities,

text.diplomatic: a perfect search they keep:
text.normalized: A perfect search they keep:
text.reading: a perfect search they keep:

text.diplomatic: Of each of them the inward thought,
text.normalized: Of each of them the inward thought,
text.reading: Of each of them the inward thought,

text.diplomatic: and very heart, is deep.
text.normalized: And very heart, is deep.
text.reading: and very heart, is deep.

text.diplomatic: God shall an arrow shoot at them,
text.normalized: God shall an arrow shoot at them,
text.reading: God shall an arrow shoot at them,

text.diplomatic: and wound them suddenly:
text.normalized: And wound them suddenly:
text.reading: and wound them suddenly:

text.diplomatic: So their own tongue shall them confound;
text.normalized: So their own tongue shall them confound;
text.reading: So their own tongue shall them confound;

text.diplomatic: all who them see shall fly.
text.normalized: All who them see shall fly.
text.reading: all who them see shall fly.

text.diplomatic: And on all men a fear shall fall,
text.normalized: And on all men a fear shall fall,
text.reading: And on all men a fear shall fall,

text.diplomatic: God’s works they shall declare;
text.normalized: God’s works they shall declare;
text.reading: God’s works they shall declare;

text.diplomatic: For they shall wisely notice take
text.normalized: For they shall wisely notice take
text.reading: For they shall wisely notice take

text.diplomatic: what these his doings are.
text.normalized: What these his doings are.
text.reading: what these his doings are.

text.diplomatic: In God the righteous shall rejoice,
text.normalized: In God the righteous shall rejoice,
text.reading: In God the righteous shall rejoice,

text.diplomatic: and trust upon his might;
text.normalized: And trust upon his might;
text.reading: and trust upon his might;

text.diplomatic: Yea, they shall greatly glory all
text.normalized: Yea, they shall greatly glory all
text.reading: Yea, they shall greatly glory all

text.diplomatic: in heart that are upright.
text.normalized: In heart that are upright.
text.reading: in heart that are upright.
